intent: Decorative lead glyph that maps a Gap or Padding spacing dimension to its canonical Inspector/canvas icon.

tokens.note: No color tokens bound in source — renders a Lucide glyph that inherits currentColor from the host row. Hardcoded values: default size 14 (overridable via size prop), strokeWidth 1.5.

a11y.role: none — decorative glyph rendered with aria-hidden, skipped by assistive tech.
a11y.labeling: Carries no accessible name; the paired numeric editor's own label conveys the spacing meaning.
a11y.attributes: data-icon-semantic exposes the resolved semantic (e.g. gap-horizontal, padding-left) for QA/tests, not for AT.
